items.raw_excerpt: Despite the reference to a cart, this French expression has nothing to do with one in its modern usage.
items.summary_en: This is a French expression of the day. The phrase etre charrette does not actually mean a cart today. It is a slang insult used to call someone annoying.
items.summary_ko: 오늘의 프랑스어 표현을 소개합니다. etre charrette는 실제로 수레를 뜻하지 않습니다. 이 표현은 어떤 사람을 성가시게 구는 사람이라고 꽤 강한 욕설로 쓰입니다.
items.title_en: French Expression of the Day: Etre Charrette
items.title_original: French Expression of the Day: Être charrette

items.summary_en: Colo Colo faces Audax Italiano in the Copa Chile. The winner of this first tie will take a spot in the quarterfinals. Colo Colo needs to break through Audax's strong defense.

items.raw_excerpt: The Tour Montparnasse, the highest skyscraper in inner city Paris – and notorious as its ugliest building – faces a future without a long-anticipated renovation after its co-owners voted against the project.
items.summary_en: The Tour Montparnasse is the tallest building in central Paris. Its owners voted against a long-planned renovation. The tower is famous for how plain it looks.
items.summary_ko: 투르 몽파르나스는 파리 도심에서 가장 높은 빌딩이다. 이 건물은 보기 흉한 외관으로 널리 알려져 있다. 소유자들이 오랫동안|gray 준비한 개축안에 반대해 투표했고, 결국 개선 계획이 무산됐다.
items.title_en: Paris' ugliest tall building has no plan for a fix

items.title_original: Tour Montparnasse: Paris' 'ugliest' skyscraper faces uncertain future
